exampleSentences.en: His verbose emails always took too long to read.
exampleSentences.zh: 他冗長的郵件總是要花太長時間閱讀。

exampleSentences.en: Academic writing should avoid verbose language in favor of precision.
exampleSentences.zh: 學術寫作應避免冗長的語言，轉而追求精確。

verbose.mnemonicHint: verb(word) + ose → 字太多的 → 冗長的

exampleSentences.en: Hang the mirror vertically beside the narrow bookshelf.
exampleSentences.zh: 把鏡子垂直掛在窄書架旁邊。

exampleSentences.en: A vertical line on the graph represents the rate of population growth.
exampleSentences.zh: 圖表上的垂直線代表人口成長率。

vertical.mnemonicHint: vert- 有「轉、朝向」的詞根意象；vertical 就像從地面直直朝天空延伸。可聯想座標圖的 vertical axis 是上下方向，與 horizontal 相反。

exampleSentences.en: The two children vied for the front seat of the car.
exampleSentences.zh: 兩個孩子爭著坐汽車前座。

exampleSentences.en: Three candidates vied for the scholarship awarded by the university.
exampleSentences.zh: 三名候選人競逐大學頒發的獎學金。

vied for.mnemonicHint: vie 是競爭，vied for 是曾爭取

exampleSentences.en: The view from our hotel room includes the entire harbor.
exampleSentences.zh: 從我們的飯店房間可以看到整座港口。

exampleSentences.en: The new evidence challenges the traditional view of early human migration.
exampleSentences.zh: 新證據挑戰了對早期人類遷徙的傳統觀點。

view.mnemonicHint: view 可看景色，也可表示看法

exampleSentences.en: Several viewers left helpful comments under my cooking video.
exampleSentences.zh: 幾位觀眾在我的烹飪影片下留下了實用的留言。

exampleSentences.en: The researchers measured how long viewers focused on each advertisement.
exampleSentences.zh: 研究人員測量觀眾注視每則廣告的時間。

viewers.mnemonicHint: view 加 er 是觀看者，再加 s 表多人

exampleSentences.en: A virus kept me home for three days.
exampleSentences.zh: 病毒感染讓我在家休息了三天。

exampleSentences.en: The virus can remain infectious outside its host for several hours.
exampleSentences.zh: 該病毒可在宿主體外維持數小時的感染力。

virus.mnemonicHint: virus 與 viral 同族，都是病毒相關。
